newsitem.title: USA: Rexall, Twinlab in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Rexall, Twinlab in merger talks.

text.p: Rexall Sundown Inc. and Twinlab Corp. said Tuesday they were in "substantial" talks regarding a merger of the two makers of vitamins and nutritional supplements.
The deal is valued at about $704 million, based on the companies' stock prices on Tuesday.
Rexall, based in Boca Raton, Fla., is expected to issue 0.74 shares of its common stock for each of Twinlab's 27 million shares outstanding in a pooling of interests.
Rexall's stock fell $3.75 to $35.25, while Ronkonkoma, N.Y.-based Twinlab fell 25 cents to $23.75 on Nasdaq shortly after midday.
The companies said there can be no assurances a definitive agreement will be reached. If the deal occurs, the companies said they expect it to be accretive to earnings.
A Rexall spokeswoman declined to elaborate on the deal. Twinlab officials were not immediately available to comment.
Twinlab and Rexall are leading developers, manufacturers and distributors of vitamins, nutritional supplements and consumer health products.
